summary: replacePathParam additionally encodes '+' and '@' after cliutil.EscapePathParam.
reason: url.PathEscape leaves '+' and '@' in path segments, but beehiiv's router misreads them in by_email paths such as /subscriptions/by_email/{email}.
validated_outcome: TestReplacePathParamEscapesReservedCharacters (carried from the prior print) passes against the strict encoder.
